generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: 1.The Bidder should have executed Routine/Preventive/Breakdown Maintenance works of Electrical/ Instrumentation and control of any power plant of 210 MW or above capacity thermal power plants.2.The bidder should have satisfactorily executed at least one similar work, as a prime contractor for an amount of not less than Rs.82.62 Lakhs (Exclusive of GST) in a single work order in any one of the preceding five financial years (i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26). 3.Work done value for previous years shall be given weightage of 10 percentage year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year, in which tenders are invited. 4.The intending bidder shall submit the single work order or single work order with extension if any and relevant work done certificate as a documentary proof issued by the competent authority. On demand original shall be produced for verification.

The Bidder should have achieved a minimum annual turnover of Rs.330.47 Lakhs (Exclusive of GST) in any of the two of the preceding five financial years (i.e., 2021- 22 to 2025-26).2.The bidder shall furnish the profit and loss statement duly certified by chartedaccountant as a documentary proof. On demand, originals shall be produced for verification.3.Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10 percentage year to bring them to present price level of the financial year in which tenders are invited.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder shall hold a valid Class-I Electrical contractor license issued by Electrical Inspectorate OR competent authority. If the electrical license is issued by other than State Government of Karnataka, the bidder should get Electrical License OR Consent Letter from Electrical Inspectorate to Government of Karnataka within two months from the date of issue of Work order. A Declaration to this effect shall be furnished by the intending bidder along with the bid as per ANNEXURE II.
